module origen_128196 (
    input wire FCLK_IN,
    inout wire [7:0] BUS_DATA,
    input wire [15:0] ADD,
    input wire RD_B,
    input wire WR_B,
    inout wire [7:0] FD,
    input wire FREAD,
    input wire FSTROBE,
    input wire FMODE,
    input wire [63:0][63:0] HIT,
    input wire TRIGGER,
    output wire CLK_BX,
    output wire [1:0] RESET,
    output wire OUT_DATA,
    output wire [63:0][63:0] HIT_OR
);

    // Internal wires and registers
    wire clk;
    wire reset_n;
    reg [7:0] data_in;
    reg [7:0] data_out;
    reg [15:0] address;
    reg read_enable;
    reg write_enable;
    reg [7:0] fd_in;
    reg [7:0] fd_out;
    reg fread_reg;
    reg fstrobe_reg;
    reg fmode_reg;
    reg [63:0][63:0] hit_reg;
    reg trigger_reg;
    reg clk_bx_reg;
    reg [1:0] reset_reg;
    reg out_data_reg;
    reg [63:0][63:0] hit_or_reg;

    // Clock and reset
    assign clk = FCLK_IN;
    assign reset_n = ~RESET[0];

    // Bidirectional bus handling
    assign BUS_DATA = (RD_B == 1'b0) ? data_out : 8'bz;
    assign FD = (FREAD == 1'b0) ? fd_out : 8'bz;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            data_in <= 8'b0;
            fd_in <= 8'b0;
        end else begin
            data_in <= BUS_DATA;
            fd_in <= FD;
        end
    end

    // Input registers
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            address <= 16'b0;
            read_enable <= 1'b0;
            write_enable <= 1'b0;
            fread_reg <= 1'b0;
            fstrobe_reg <= 1'b0;
            fmode_reg <= 1'b0;
            hit_reg <= {64{64'b0}};
            trigger_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            address <= ADD;
            read_enable <= ~RD_B;
            write_enable <= ~WR_B;
            fread_reg <= FREAD;
            fstrobe_reg <= FSTROBE;
            fmode_reg <= FMODE;
            hit_reg <= HIT;
            trigger_reg <= TRIGGER;
        end
    end

    // Output registers
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin
            clk_bx_reg <= 1'b0;
            reset_reg <= 2'b0;
            out_data_reg <= 1'b0;
            hit_or_reg <= {64{64'b0}};
        end else begin
            clk_bx_reg <= ~clk_bx_reg;
            reset_reg <= {reset_reg[0], ~reset_n};
            out_data_reg <= |fd_in;
            hit_or_reg <= hit_reg;
        end
    end

    // Output assignments
    assign CLK_BX = clk_bx_reg;
    assign RESET = reset_reg;
    assign OUT_DATA = out_data_reg;
    assign HIT_OR = hit_or_reg;

    // Add your submodule instantiations and additional logic here

endmodule
